signature_scores.notes: In p53+/+ HCT116 cells, serine/glycine withdrawal triggers transient p53-p21 (CDKN1A) cell-cycle arrest that promotes survival by channelling depleted serine stores into glutathione synthesis, preserving antioxidant capacity (Nature 2012). Directionality is protective for the p53-WT state under this modifier.
signature_scores.modifier_agent: Serine/glycine starvation (-SG medium; dietary serine/glycine depletion in vivo)

interactions.curator_notes: [Mechanistic Bridging -- model-generated hypothesis, not a tested result] Serine/glycine starvation (-SG medium; dietary serine/glycine depletion in vivo) induces a nrf2_ferroptosis signature (protective_resistance) in HCT116; Metformin's reported resistance mechanism runs through the same pathway (SLC7A11/xCT cystine-glutamate antiporter). Because the modifier's effect on this pathway is protective/resistance-conferring (reinforces the same pathway the drug's resistance depends on), this predicts antagonism and is logged here rather than surfaced as a synergy candidate. This combination has not been evaluated together in any cited study -- it is a candidate for testing, generated by matching independently-curated signature and resistance-mechanism evidence, not a direct or inferred empirical finding.

resistance_mechanism.mechanism_description: High SLC7A11/xCT expression sustains cystine import and glutathione synthesis, protecting against metformin-induced ferroptosis; metformin acts in part by destabilizing SLC7A11 via UFMylation inhibition (Yang et al. 2021, [S8] above).

resistance_mechanism.mechanism_description: GPX4 detoxifies lipid peroxides downstream of cystine/glutathione depletion; sufficient GPX4 activity (or an intact glutathione pool feeding it) can rescue cells from erastin's system Xc- blockade despite cystine starvation (Dixon et al. 2012; Yang et al. 2014).
